topic: The Monthly Twenty: a 20-minute calendar check from today to the end of December, listing every day likely to cost money so your second number has no surprises
pillar: THE MONTHLY TWENTY: a gentle weekly or monthly reset, looking at your three numbers again, one small step.
caption:
December has a way of sneaking up on a budget.

This week's Monthly Twenty is a calendar check. Open your phone calendar and scroll from today to the end of December.
Write down every day that might cost money, with a rough guess next to each one.
Then circle the one that worries you most and pick one small step for it.

Save this so you can do it tonight or next Sunday.
If you'd like a page made for this, The Day Zero Workbook is $17 at the link in bio.

Day one counts.

General education, not financial advice.

#lifeafterdivorce #budgetingforbeginners #holidaybudget #moneyreset #startingover

slides.title: Open your calendar before December does
slides.subtitle: A 20-minute look at the month ahead

slides.title: Your second number has a calendar
slides.body: What goes out each month moves around. December often brings gifts, travel and bills that only show up once a year. A quick look now gives you a head start.

slides.title: What you need
items: One page or a notes app
Last December's statement, if you can find it

slides.title: The 20-minute calendar check
items: Scroll day by day from today to the end of December
Write down any day that will likely cost money
Add a rough guess next to each one
Check last December's statement for anything you missed
Circle the one that worries you most

slides.title: Three lines on one page
slides.body: Gas for a family visit, $60. A school gift swap, $25. A yearly app renewal, $40. That's $125, and now it has a name and a date.

slides.title: Mark what matters to you first
slides.body: If a holiday dinner with your sister is worth it, write keep next to it. Then look at the rest of the list with a calm eye.

slides.title: Pick one thing to do this week
slides.body: Look at the circled item. You might set aside a little each week, ask about a lower gift limit, or cancel that renewal. One step is plenty for today.

slides.title: Come back to this next Sunday
slides.body: The Day Zero Workbook has a month-ahead page and your Three Numbers in one place. It's $17 at the link in bio, if it helps. Day one counts.
